Introduction:
NL is a 16-year-old premenarchal junior in high school who
competes on high school cross country and track teams.
She is an endurance athlete competing at regional and state
events. After a training run today, she complained of diz-
ziness. Mother states that patient has lost a lot of weight
over the past six months. Her mother does not know exact
amount but seven months ago patient began training for
her ﬁ rst marathon. Patient states she has not lost enough
weight and her recent performance has been hampered by
weight. Mother states she trains constantly, even going out
for additional runs after homework in the evening.
